parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is a rotation lid of a box made of cardboard, forming one of the top flaps that can open or close the box.
parts.Functional_description: It functions as a cover to protect the contents of the box and can be opened or closed to access the interior.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the top edge of the box, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: This is another rotation lid of the box made of cardboard, forming one of the opposite top flaps.
parts.Functional_description: It works together with the other lid to fully close the box and secure its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its hinge line at the top edge of the box, moving in coordination with the other lid.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the box made of cardboard, forming the main container structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main storage space and structural support for the box, holding the contents securely.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move; it supports the lids and maintains the box’s shape.
